title: Item:Elixir of Frosty Luck
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
Drinking this elixir grants your character an additional chance of finding {{Item|Frozen Key}}s and [[Snowpeaks Festival|Snowpeaks Coin]]s from every chest you loot.
